SwiftUiTheme и тема

Чтение темы, цвета, типографика, метрики и параметры стекла.

Как выглядит

Что это

SwiftUiTheme.of(context) отдаёт SwiftUiThemeData. Подробно — в гайде «Тема и цвета».

final t = SwiftUiTheme.of(context);
Text('Hi', style: t.typography.body.copyWith(color: t.colors.foregroundSecondary));

SwiftUiGlassTheme
ПараметрТипПо умолчаниюОписание
glassFillColorrequired
glassBorderLightColorrequired
glassBorderDarkColorrequired
glassShadowColorrequired
glassIconColorrequired
glassSigmadoublerequiredSigma of the flat glass surfaces (buttons).
liquidBezeldoublerequiredBezel width in logical px where light bends.
liquidRefractiondoublerequiredRim displacement multiplier (1 = native-like: the rim zone shows the content from liquidBezel deep).
liquidBlurdoublerequiredGaussian sigma (logical px) of the blur under the plate.
liquidSaturationdoublerequired
liquidDispersiondoublerequired
liquidMagnifydoublerequired< 1 magnifies the middle of the plate a little.
liquidHdrdoublerequiredPeak brightness of the press highlight and rim, in SDR-white units. 1.0 = SDR only.
liquidPrefilterdoublerequiredShare of the blur done by an engine blur pass before the shader (0..1). The shader blurs with 40 taps, which aliases thin features (1 px lines, text strokes); a prefilter of about half the sigma removes that for the price of one extra pass per plate or group.
liquidSpeculardoublerequired
liquidGlowdoublerequired
liquidToneLiftdoublerequiredLuminance tone map of the glass interior: out = lift + gain * in (fitted to native glass on a gray ramp). Identity: lift 0, gain 1.
liquidToneGaindoublerequired
liquidTintColorrequiredTint laid over the refracted backdrop (alpha = amount).
useLiquidGlassboolrequiredGlass buttons/plates use the liquid glass shader (when the renderer supports it) instead of the flat glass painter.
SwiftUiChromeTheme
ПараметрТипПо умолчаниюОписание
topChromeStyleconst ChromeStyle.soft()The style of the top / bottom edge.
bottomChromeStyleconst ChromeStyle.soft()
blurTintColorrequiredThe scrim colour of the blur styles.
blurSigmadouble10Max sigma of the progressive blur at the very screen edge.
blurExtradouble36How far (logical px) the zone extends past the last bar.
tintOpacitydouble0.35Opacity of the scrim laid over the zone (the styles that need a stronger one than the masked blur's 0.12).
bottomBarSafeAreaSharedouble0.30..1: the share of the bottom safe area (the home indicator) kept below the bottom bar. 1 lifts the bar by the whole inset, 0 presses it to the very edge.
topEdgeRampdouble16Scroll distance (logical px) over which the top edge effect fades in once the content starts to move under the bar. At rest (nothing under the bar yet) there is no effect, so the first rows are not blurred or dimmed; like the scroll edge effect of iOS 26.
SwiftUiAdaptiveTheme
ПараметрТипПо умолчаниюОписание
regularWidthdouble600A window at least this wide has the regular horizontal size class (the outer display of a foldable, 466 pt, is compact; its inner display, about 669 pt, is regular).
regularHeightdouble500A window at least this tall has the regular vertical size class (a phone in portrait is regular, in landscape compact).
readableWidthdouble672The comfortable width of text and rows on a wide window (like the readable content guide of iOS).
